title: Path event table row (jax_fem_am --path-file CSV)
description: Row-level schema for the scan-path event table. File-level constraints (strictly increasing time, 1-based layer ordering, recoat convention) are checked by the validator in the AM-Sim repo, not by this schema.

time.description: End time of the row [s]; strictly increasing across rows

power.description: Laser power used by the solver [W]; same semantics as --laser-power

mode.description: Label: scan, jump, recoat, dwell, ...; empty means path

front_coord.description: Activation front along the build axis, mesh coordinates
